items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: We got back and well I had worked with Bauduc in the service

ctx.x: Right. When you returned to California after the service, is this when the studios beckoned you?

Yeah. I keep saying, oh it took a while, but I never thought about it. We got back and well I had worked with Bauduc in the service, and — see I should write all this down for my memoirs. At one point, no that’s right, I came back, oh, I went to work with Savitt. That was first guy, back at the Casino Gardens. And he had the band in there and I worked with him and wrote a couple of arrangements, and for a few weeks, they used to change bands every three or four weeks. And it was coming to the end of that

engagement and he called me in the back and he says — oh and then after that, Will Osborne had contacted me, that he was going to go up and down the coast with forming new band, and would I come with him. He got Jimmy Mundy is writing the book, and Eileen Wilson is going to be the singer. And I said I never had been on the road with a band. That’s what I’d always — gosh wouldn’t that be great you know. So anyhow before we were through on the Savitt thing, he called me back and he said, “Ray, what are you going to…
